SUNY LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Information for visitors to the SUNY website.

Last updated: September 18, 2026

1. Scope

This Privacy Policy explains how Xiamen Suny Electronic Co., Ltd. ("SUNY", "we", "us") handles personal information provided through this website or when you contact us in connection with a business inquiry.

2. Information we may process

If you contact us by email, telephone or another business channel, we may process your name, company, business contact details, country or region, project requirements, drawings, specifications and other information you choose to provide.

The project brief form currently available on this website creates a local text file on your device and does not automatically transmit the form contents to SUNY.

3. Purposes

We use information to respond to inquiries, evaluate technical requirements, prepare quotations or proposals, support project development, maintain business records, protect website security and comply with applicable legal obligations.

4. Sharing

We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers or professional advisers where reasonably necessary for website operation, business support, legal compliance or protection of rights.

5. International access

Our customers and website visitors may be located in different countries. Business communications may therefore involve cross-border processing where necessary to respond to an inquiry or support a project.

6. Retention and security

We retain business information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose and apply appropriate organizational and technical measures to protect it.

7. Your choices

Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction or deletion of personal information that we hold about you, or ask questions about our handling of your information.

8. Contact

Privacy inquiries: gm@xmsuny.com.

SUNY 法律信息

隐私政策

适用于三立电子官方网站访问者的相关说明。

最后更新：2026 年 9 月 18 日

1. 适用范围

本隐私政策说明厦门三立电子有限公司（“三立电子”或“我们”）如何处理您通过本网站或商务沟通渠道向我们提供的个人信息。

2. 我们可能处理的信息

当您通过电子邮件、电话或其他商务渠道联系我们时，我们可能处理您的姓名、公司、商务联系方式、国家或地区、项目需求、图纸、规格以及您主动提供的其他信息。

本网站当前的项目需求表单仅在您的设备上生成本地文本文件，不会自动将表单内容传输给三立电子。

3. 使用目的

我们可能将相关信息用于回复咨询、评估技术需求、准备报价或方案、支持项目开发、维护商务记录、保障网站安全以及履行适用的法律义务。

4. 信息共享

我们不会出售个人信息。在网站运营、业务支持、法律合规或维护合法权益所必需的情况下，我们可能与服务提供商或专业顾问共享必要信息。

5. 跨境访问

我们的客户及网站访问者可能来自不同国家或地区。为回复咨询或支持项目，商务沟通可能涉及必要的跨境信息处理。

6. 保存与安全

我们仅在相关目的所合理需要的期限内保存商务信息，并采取适当的组织和技术措施保护信息安全。

7. 您的选择

在适用法律允许的范围内，您可以请求查询、更正或删除我们持有的相关个人信息，或就我们的信息处理方式提出问题。

8. 联系方式

隐私相关问题请联系：gm@xmsuny.com。
